KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 2
SUBJECT: KISWAHILI ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When practising Huyo na Hao, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” Huyo na Hao.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Huyo na Hao.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Huyo na Hao.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Huyo na Hao.

2. When practising Msamiati, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Msamiati.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Msamiati.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Msamiati.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.

3. When practising Anga, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Anga.
   B. Use insults to “practise” Anga.
   C. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Anga.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Anga.

4. Wingi wa “mtoto” ni: (1 mark)
   A. mitoto
   B. kitoto
   C. watoto
   D. mato

5. Kinyume cha “refu” ni: (1 mark)
   A. fupi
   B. zito
   C. nene
   D. pana

6. When practising Hadithi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Copy random text without understanding Hadithi.
   B. Avoid reading anything related to Hadithi.
   C. Use insults to “practise” Hadithi.
   D. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Hadithi.

7. When practising herufi kubwa, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Use insults to “practise” herufi kubwa.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for herufi kubwa.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to herufi kubwa.
   D. Copy random text without understanding herufi kubwa.

8. When practising Masimulizi, which approach is best? (1 mark)
   A. Avoid reading anything related to Masimulizi.
   B. Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Masimulizi.
   C. Copy random text without understanding Masimulizi.
   D. Use insults to “practise” Masimulizi.

9. Ni sentensi ipi iliyo sahihi kisarufi? (1 mark)
   A. Anasoma mwanafunzi kitabu ya.
   B. Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.
   C. Mwanafunzi anasoma vitabu mzuri.
   D. Kitabu anasoma mwanafunzi kwa.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
10. In three clear sentences, explain Nambari 11-50 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

11. In three clear sentences, explain Msamiati and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Masimulizi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Hadithi and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:

====

2. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Msamiati.

3. C — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Anga.

4. C — watoto

5. A — fupi

6. D — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Hadithi.

7. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for herufi kubwa.

8. B — Use clear examples, correct form, and a short local context for Masimulizi.

9. B — Mwanafunzi anasoma kitabu.

13. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Hadithi; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
